text: THE DESIGN SYSTEM'S OWN COMPONENTS NOW COMPOSE BUTTON AND ICONBUTTON INSTEAD OF REDRAWING THEM. Of the 107 raw <button> elements inside packages/design-system, 32 became Button or IconButton — every close, dismiss, retry, refresh, remove, send, capture and month-step, plus ErrorView's actions, the chart frame's retry and table toggle, the carousel's arrows and play control, and the pagination jump. The other 75 stay native and each now declares why on the tag: the control IS the component (Button's own root, a Tabs tab, a Menu item, a listbox trigger, a calendar gridcell, a pager page, a carousel dot, an accordion trigger, a drop surface, a photo's scrim disc, the chatbot launcher the corner rail measures, the statutory accessibility bar's steppers). Around 280 lines of hand-drawn button CSS are deleted: each replaced control inherits the ladder's ink, focus ring, disabled state and forced-colors treatment from button.css instead of restating them, and the local rules that remain name .ds-btn or .ds-icon-btn so they outrank it deterministically inside the shared components layer. Three deliberate differences: a chart's retry now carries the 3:1 border every other outlined button uses (the old hairline measured 2.15:1, below WCAG 1.4.11), the chatbot's disabled send matches every other disabled filled button, and the pagination jump button takes the 64px rhythm minimum. Two Figma-facing tokens, cmp/button/primary/bgHover and /text, lost their last consumer when the biometric capture button became a Button; they stay in the library because the Figma master binds them.
